entries.desc: The children of a once famous artist hire a forger to complete some unfinished, long ago abandoned canvases so they'll have an inheritance when he dies.

entries.title: Black Doves
entries.desc: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

entries.title: Yellowjackets
entries.desc: A wildly talented girls' high school soccer team become the unlucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness.
